typography.notes: Do not use Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for large headings. Use Manrope for tabular data and weights for better numeric legibility. Ensure responsive fluid scales clamp up to text-5xl max.

layouts.pos_tablet: Mobile-first, touch-friendly. 2-column or 3-column bento grid for products on the left (70%), fixed cart summary on the right (30%). Use large touch targets (min h-14) for weight/qty keypad. Focus on fast transaction flow.
layouts.owner_dashboard: High-density Grid Mode B (grid-cols-4). Strict hierarchy, compact spacing (gap-4 or gap-6). Flat cards with 1px border. Charts for HPP, Sales, and Yield (Rendemen). Provide real-time feed visualization.
layouts.laptop_admin: Dense data tables, comprehensive forms for Stock and Slaughter (Pemotongan), wide layout for complex filtering and report exports.
layouts.navigation: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/70 or solid background. HIDE desktop links on hamburger menu is FORBIDDEN. Visible links required.

components_and_styling.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components_and_styling.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with clear hover states (darker hue + text-white). Touch targets on POS must be oversized.
components_and_styling.forms: Use Shadcn components. No native inputs. For weights, ensure a custom keypad or large numeric input is available on the POS.
components_and_styling.dropdowns: MUST have solid backgrounds. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds anywhere.
components_and_styling.badges: Use colored status badges (Success, Warning, Danger) for real-time stock/activity feed to allow quick visual scanning.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Never use 'transition: all', specify properties.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.
Format currency as 'Rp 35.000' and weight as '3,25 kg' exactly using custom formatters.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Provide clear feedback via Sonner toasts for all transactions and stock warnings.
Do not use centered alignment for main app container. Always align left for inputs, dense text, and tabular data.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (use .js files ONLY, DO NOT use .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, Recharts for Owner Dashboards, Sonner for Toasts.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Generous Spacing for POS. Use Tight Spacing (gap-4/6) for Admin/Owner Dashboard. Implement the specific color variables in tailwind config.
instructions_to_main_agent.logic: Mock the POS and Dashboard views with a simple navigation/toggle mechanism to switch between 'Kasir POS', 'Owner Phone Dashboard', and 'Laptop Admin'. Implement rendemen calculation logic mockup (Live Weight vs Carcass Weight).
instructions_to_main_agent.formatting: Create utils/format.js with formatRupiah and formatWeight functions specifically for IDR and Indonesian locales (using comma for decimal, e.g., '3,25 kg').
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure EVERY button, input, and key div has a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or install @phosphor-icons/react for premium duotone icons in the POS grid.
